providers.title: Dirichlet's approximation theorem
providers.scope: Every irrational x has infinitely many coprime p/q with 0 < |x − p/q| < 1/q^2; hence mu(x) >= 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Liouville's theorem
providers.scope: A real algebraic number of degree n >= 2 satisfies |x − p/q| >= c q^(−n) for all p/q; hence mu(x) <= n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Formal inverse function theorem
providers.scope: A local homomorphism of power series rings in n variables with invertible linear part is an isomorphism.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exponential of commuting derivations
providers.scope: For commuting derivations D_i of a Q-algebra R, f -> sum_alpha D^alpha f b^alpha / alpha! is a ring homomorphism R -> R[[b]].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Weighted transverse multiplicity
providers.scope: If polynomials of weighted degree <= N have all derivatives of cost < epsilon N along a commuting frame vanishing on a component Z of codimension k, then prod_{a in A} rho_a <= k! epsilon^(−k) prod_{b in B} kappa_b for all coordinate and frame normal bases A, B of Z.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separated weights
providers.scope: Thresholds for w_1, ..., w_m, depending only on the fixed data and the earlier weights (not on the centres), make the weights separated.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The curve inequality
providers.scope: With separated weights, every algebraic curve in C^(m+1) has deg_W C >= (1 + sigma) times its total weighted contact with the logarithmic curves at the centres.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separated-weight interpolation
providers.scope: With separated weights, polynomials of W-degree <= H realize every packet of jets of V-weight < H along the logarithmic curves at K centres with distinct coordinates, for all large H divisible by R.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ampleness on the blow-up
providers.scope: On the blow-up of the jet ideal, A − E is ample: a positive multiple is a positive combination of the nef class from the curve inequality and an ample class.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Direct images of twists on a blow-up
providers.scope: For the blow-up p of a coherent ideal I, p_* O(−nE) = I^n and R^q p_* O(−nE) = 0 (q > 0) for all large n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Size of lcm(1, ..., n)
providers.scope: log lcm(1, ..., n) <= 4 n log 2 for every n >= 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Arithmetic lower bound
providers.scope: A nonzero full-row minor of the interpolation matrix at Gaussian rational centres has log|Delta_H|/(MH) >= −(1 − bbar) − E_ar.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Collision estimate
providers.scope: A determinant of Taylor-coefficient rows of entire functions, with n_a rows testing the same function, is at most exp(−(log 2/4) sum n_a^2 + MH(E_hol + o(1))).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Determinant comparison
providers.scope: If g > 0, E_ar + E_an < g and c L > 1 + E_ar + E_an, approximations |pi − p_i/q_i| <= q_i^(−nu) with the interpolation hypotheses lead to a contradiction.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The irrationality exponent of pi is 2
providers.scope: For every nu > 2 there is Q(nu) with |pi − p/q| > q^(−nu) for all integers p and q >= Q(nu); hence pi is irrational and mu(pi) = 2 (OpenAI, 2026).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spacing of multiples
providers.scope: If ||q alpha|| >= c q^(1−kappa) for all q, the points q alpha, K <= q < 2K, are d-separated on the circle with d = c (2K)^(1−kappa).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Generalized Flint–Hills series
providers.scope: sum n^(−a) |sin n|^(−b) converges if and only if a > max(1, b); in particular sum 1/(n^3 sin^2 n) converges.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
